'''Raymon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he had joined the cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] and lived in their camp near [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was tasked with sending new cult members to their pilgrimage, a test serving as initiation in the Order of Revan.
